full_prompt_en: A square surreal graphic illustration places a very small standing person before an immense eye-shaped form that fills the right two-thirds of the image. The person stands in the lower-left center, wearing a long dark green coat and looking toward the huge dark pupil. A narrow shadow falls diagonally to the right across a bright yellow ground. The eye is built from thick concentric bands of muted teal, deep blue, mustard yellow, olive, warm orange, and red, wrapped around a black central oval. A small white curved gleam sits near the upper-left edge of that oval, making the abstract structure read like a glossy eye. Above and around it, heavy black and crimson shapes curve inward from the top and left, as though the surrounding world has become a giant face or cavern. The lower half is divided into broad red, orange, and ocher bands, with a yellow wedge opening toward the figure. The edges of these bands follow sweeping curves rather than straight perspective lines. Fine, tightly repeated stipple or print grain textures the colored areas, especially the foreground reds and the eye's rings. No literal horizon or realistic sky is visible. Light appears graphic and concentrated on the yellow plane, giving the tiny figure a crisp dark silhouette while the large colored surfaces remain evenly legible. The entire frame is a confrontation of scale: a still human mark at the base of a vast circular gaze, held together by rhythmic nested color and bold black negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实图形插画把一个极小的站立人物放在占据右侧三分之二的巨大眼形前。人物位于左下中央，穿深绿色长外套，望向庞大的黑色瞳孔。窄影斜向右方投在亮黄地面上。眼形由厚重同心色带构成，柔青绿、深蓝、芥黄、橄榄色、暖橘和红色环住中央黑色椭圆。椭圆左上边有一道小白弯亮痕，让抽象结构看起来像发亮的眼睛。其上和周围，沉重黑色与绯红形状从顶部及左边向内卷，仿佛世界变成巨大面孔或洞穴。下半幅被宽阔红、橘和赭黄色带划开，一块黄色楔形朝人物敞开。这些色带边缘沿大曲线走，而非笔直透视线。细密重复点纹或印刷颗粒覆盖彩色区域，前景红色与眼圈尤明显。看不到真实地平线或天空。光感图形化，集中在黄色平面上，使小人物形成清晰深色剪影，大块彩色表面则均匀可读。全画是一场尺度对峙：巨大圆形凝视底部的一笔静止人影，靠有节奏的套叠颜色和大胆黑色留白维系整体。
style_prompt_en: Graphic illustration uses monumental nested curves, sharply isolated black voids, and finely stippled color fields. Organize a large concentric focal form with bands of teal, blue, mustard, olive, ocher, vermilion, and crimson, allowing warm and cool stripes to alternate rhythmically. Set one tiny dark scale mark on a bright plane so the surrounding form feels overwhelming. Broad sweeping edges create depth without a literal vanishing point, while a small gloss highlight can imply rounded surface. Fine print-like grain gives otherwise flat color tactile density. Keep light graphic and directional enough to leave a crisp shadow on the pale area, but do not model every band realistically. The transferable effect is uncanny and monumental, driven by vast scale difference, repeated color arcs, and deliberate negative space.
style_prompt_zh: 图形插画使用宏大的套叠曲线、截然分开的黑色空洞和细点纹色场。以青绿、蓝、芥黄、橄榄色、赭黄、朱红和绯红色带组织巨大同心焦点，让冷暖条带有节奏地交替。在明亮平面上放一处极小深色尺度记号，使周围形状显得压倒性。宽阔流动的边缘无需真实消失点便建立纵深，一道小亮痕还能暗示圆润表面。细密印刷感颗粒给原本平涂的颜色增加触感密度。光感保持图形化，方向足以在浅区留下清楚阴影，但不必写实塑形每一道色带。可迁移的效果诡异而宏大，由巨大尺度差、重复色弧和有意留白驱动。
theme_en: A tiny person stands before an immense multicolored eye-shaped form
theme_zh: 一名小人物站在巨大多色眼形前
name: Kazumasa Nagai
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
